recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is recommended for FHIR-40468; optional code formatting around the word contained would be editorial and not needed to satisfy the issue.
issue_request: FHIR-40468 was a Published FHIR-I change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to replace the contained-resource bullet that said the contained element is located after narrative and before extensions, because that position wording is not correct for JSON.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 4be70810dbeba46498ae4688e2d80b5be980a300, which changed source/references.html from the position-specific sentence to wording that the contained element appears as a child element at the root of the resource.
additional_context: FHIR-12500 introduced the older location wording in 2017. A 2023 Zulip thread linked to FHIR-40468 and confirms the practical concern was that JSON implementers were reading the old prose as a required property order. FHIR-I minutes on 2023-03-20 corroborate the Persuasive with Modification vote. source/fhir.ini maps Reference to the references page, confirming source/references.html is the current build-scope source for this guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/references.html contained-resource bullet already removes the JSON-invalid ordering claim and says the contained element appears as a child element at the root of the resource; searches found no remaining copy of the stale position wording.
